welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Lig dúinn a dhéanamh réidh le haghaidh do chuairt.

welcomeTitleLine1.translation: Lig dúinn a dhéanamh réidh leat

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Freagraigh ar roinnt ceisteanna faoi do chuid comharthaí. Déanfaidh do dhochtúir athbhreithniú ar gach rud sula gcomhlíonfaidh tú.

btnStart.translation: Tosaíonn sé le clárú roimh an chuairt

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Tá sé seo a nascann do chuairte le do taifid.

labelComplaint.translation: Cad a thugann tú isteach inniu?

placeholderComplaint.translation: Déan cur síos ar do phríomh-aimseartha...

interviewAsking.translation: Ag iarraidh a fháil amach faoi do chuid comharthaí

interviewLoading.translation: Ag cur isteach ar do chuid agallamh...

interviewLoadError.translation: Ní raibh muid in ann a lucháil do chuid agallamh.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Go raibh maith agat, {name} Tá mé an méid a theastaíonn uaim. A ligean ar athbhreithniú a dhéanamh ar do fhreagraí sula gcuirfidh tú iad chuig an dochtúir.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Go raibh maith agat Beidh mé a dhéanamh ar roinnt ceisteanna tapa faoi do {complaint}.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Go raibh maith agat Beidh mé a dhéanamh ar roinnt ceisteanna tapa faoi cad a thug tú isteach.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Cuir freagra isteach, nó cliceáil ar mholadh thuas

reviewTitle.translation: Seo an méid a thug mé faoi deara

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Tap aon earraí chun é a shocrú roimh sheoladh.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Breathnaíonn sé ceart sheoladh chuig an dochtúir

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Má bhraitheann do chuid comharthaí tromchúiseach nó má tá siad ag dul a bheith níos measa anois, ná bí ag fanacht glaoch ar sheirbhísí éigeandála.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Déan teagmháil le cúram laistigh de 12 uair an chloig

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Léiríonn do chuid comharthaí rud éigin a ba chóir a fheiceáil go luath.

urgencyNextSteps.translation: Cad a tharlóidh ina dhiaidh sin

urgencyStep1Title.translation: Tá do chuid gairme curtha ar fáil anois

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Gheobhaidh an fhoireann chliniciúil do stair struchtúrtha láithreach.

urgencyStep2Title.translation: Fuarthas laistigh de 12 uair an chloig

urgencyStep2Desc.en: Based on {level} urgency. You will be notified when a clinician opens it.
urgencyStep2Desc.translation: Bunaithe ar {level} práinneach, cuirfear in iúl duit nuair a osclaíonn do chlinician é.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Má tá sé níos measa, gníomhú go tapa

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Mearachú tromchúiseach nó tobann glaoch ar sheirbhísí éigeandála láithreach.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Is meastóireacht uathoibríoch é seo, ní diagnóis.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Tá tú a fheiceáil ag an ospidéal seo roimhe seo. Teachtaireacht a sheoladh díreach ansin?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Tá do taifid acu cheana féin, mar sin feiceann do fhoireann cúraim do stair iomlán láithreach.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: Cá háit ba mhaith leat a bheith le feiceáil?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Roghnaigh ospidéal Triavi atá in aice leat cuirtear do ráiteas {level} ar aghaidh ag an nóiméad a roghnaíonn tú.

findScanning.translation: Ag scanadh ospidéil Triavi in aice leat...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Ní raibh muid in ann a fháil ar do shuíomh.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Tá do chuid gairme leis an bhfoireann cúraim, cuirfimid in iúl duit an nóiméad a osclaíonn do chlinician é.

timelineReviewing.translation: Dochtúir ag athbhreithniú ar do chuid gairme

timelineOpened.translation: D'oscail do chlinicóir do chuid gairme

btnBackToDashboard.translation: Téigh ar ais go dtí an tábla rialaithe

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Má tá sé ag dul a bheith níos measa, gníomhú anois

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Ná bí ag fanacht le do shuíomh rian. Má tá do chuid comharthaí tromchúiseacha nó ag dul níos measa go tobann glaoigh le seirbhísí éigeandála anois nó téigh chuig an roinn éigeandála is gaire.

escalateClose.translation: Tá mé ceart go leor gar

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Tá muid marcáil do chás mar tosaíocht níos airde ionas go bhfuil an fhoireann cúraim ar an eolas.

notifyTitle.translation: Triavi · Tá do chuid gairme oscailte

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Tá clinicéir ag athbhreithniú ar do chuid gairme, cuirfimid nuacht ort de réir mar a théann sé chun cinn.

checkinWelcome.translation: Cén chaoi a bhfuil tú ag mothú?

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Freagraigh roinnt ceisteanna faoi conas a bhí tú ó do chuairt.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Cén chaoi a bhfuil do staid i gcomparáid le roimhe seo?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: An bhfuil rud éigin eile ba mhaith leat a insint dúinn?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Táimid sásta go bhfuil tú ag mothú níos fearr

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Déanfaimid seiceáil arís {next} a dhéanamh cinnte go bhfuil tú fós ag feabhsú.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: Féachfaidh do chlinicóir ar seo inniu

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Tá do fhreagraí curtha chuig an bhfoireann cúraim.

checkinResultEscalate.translation: Tabhair cúram anois, le do thoil.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Ná bí ag fanacht déan teagmháil le do fhoireann cúraim nó téigh chuig an roinn éigeandála is gaire.

checkinExpired.translation: Tá an nasc seiceála seo críochnaithe

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Ní bheidh an rianú seo ar fáil níos mó. Log isteach chun do sheiceáil isteach reatha a fheiceáil.

checkinExpiredSignIn.translation: Iarr isteach chun leanúint ar aghaidh

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Déan cuntas saor in aisce chun an chuairt seo a rianú agus an cód a sheachaint an chéad uair eile.

authVerifyTitle.translation: Lig dúinn a fhíorú go bhfuil tú

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Cuirfimid cód aon uair aon pasfhocal chun cuimhneamh.

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: Seoltar chuig {dest}. Tá sé tar éis 10 nóiméad.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Cuir isteach do fhón nó do ríomhphost agus cuirfimid cód sínithe isteach.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Tá do chuntas ceangailte le taifid d'ospidéal

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Cuir isteach uimhir theileafóin bailí (714 cifre)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Ní raibh sé in ann an cód a sheoladh, déan iarracht arís.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Déan tástáil ar do nasc agus déan iarracht arís.

errResendFailed.translation: Ní raibh sé in ann a sheoladh ar ais. Bain triail as arís.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Ní choinnigh an cód sin. Bain triail as arís.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Chun do shlándáil agus chun sonraí an othair a chosaint, tá tú sínithe amach tar éis tréimhse neamhghníomhaíochta.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Tosaigh clárú isteach chun tús a chur le cuairt nua.

dashNoPastVisits.translation: Níl aon chuairteanna roimhe seo fós.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Tá glaonna cúraim ag glaoch sa aip seo · ní roinntear riamh do uimhir theileafóin.

dashNextCareCall.translation: An chéad ghlao le cúram eile

dashMedPushChip.translation: Ní gá ach brú a dhéanamh

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Roghnaigh cé a ghlaoíonn tú, agus conas a fhéachann siad.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Tá sé an-sásta agus nach bhfuil sé ag dul go tapa

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Síochán Jordan, tá sé in am do do dáileog tráthnóna...

postVisitCalls.translation: Glacadh isteach tar éis an chuairt

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: "Conas a bhfuil tú ag mothú?" tar éis scaoileadh

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Níl aon ghlao ag 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification

comingSoon.translation: Tá sé ag teacht go luath

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Fanann do líne cúraim gníomhach logáil isteach ar ais chun glaonna agus cuimhneachain a bhainistiú.

callRingVerified.translation: A fhíorú · trí do líne cúraim {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Glao guth criptithe · WebRTC · ní roinntear do uimhir riamh

callSummaryNextCareCall.translation: An chéad ghlao le cúram eile

callSummaryBack.translation: Téigh ar ais go dtí an tábla rialaithe

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Ní féidir ach tú féin agus {hospital} iad a fheiceáil.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Níl aon cúram ag teastáil ar an gcuairte seo fós.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Tá sé seo achoimre roinnte leat ní diagnóis. Má athraíonn do chuid comharthaí nó tá siad níos measa, iarr cúram éigeandála láithreach.

visitDetailNotFound.translation: Ní raibh muid in ann an cuairt sin a fháil

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: B'fhéidir go ndearnadh an t-amharc seo a bhaint, nó nach bhfuil an nasc bailí níos mó. Téigh ar ais chun do stair iomlán a fheiceáil.

visitDetailBackToVisits.translation: Téigh ar ais go dtí cuairtanna roimhe seo

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: A scaoileadh ag do fhoireann cúraim

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Déan do chuid sonraí a nuashonrú, feicfidh do dochtúir an chuid is déanaí.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Athraíonn sé teanga gach scáileán láithreach.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ní raibh in ann cóipeáil - roghnaigh agus cóipeáil go lámhaigh

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Cad a chosaint, agus cad a rialú tú.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Déantar do ainm, do shonraí teagmhála, agus do fhreagraí téacs saor in aisce a scriosadh sula dtéann rud ar bith as do ospidéal. Ní fheiceann ach do fhoireann cúraim sonraí aitheanta; ní fheiceann taighde agus anailís ach sonraí neamh-aithanta.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Ceadaigh sonraí neamh-aithniúla chun cúram a fheabhsú do gach duine. Is féidir leat é seo a athrú ag am ar bith.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Is féidir leat seo a athrú ag am ar bith.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Déan do chuntas agus sonraí teagmhála a bhaint go buan.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Iarr cóip de do achoimre cuairt, cógais, agus stair glac cúram.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Ní féidir é seo a dhéanamh ar ais. Ní féidir é seo a dhéanamh.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Tabharfaidh do fhoireann cúraim do dhearbhú trí ríomhphost laistigh de 72 uair an chloig.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Roghnaigh cruth agus iarr ar do onnmhairí. Beidh muid ag ullmhú é agus a sheoladh nasc sábháilte chuig do ríomhphost cláraithe.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Cuirfimid nasc slán ar do sheoladh chláraithe laistigh de 24 uair an chloig.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Níl aon comhad a íoslódáil anseo - tá do taifid a sheoladh go sábháilte chuig do ríomhphost cláraithe.

ariaBackToInviteLink.translation: Téigh ar ais chun cuireadh nasc

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: An glao críochnaithe? logáilte mar aon teagmháil

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Paste an nasc cuireadh a sheoladh chuig an ospidéal, nó scánáil a gcód QR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Ní cosúil leis sin Triavi cuireadh nasc nó cód.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code
inviteScanSubtitle.translation: Cuir do chamara i dtreo an chód

inviteCameraDenied.translation: Ní féidir rochtain a fháil ar an gcamara

inviteCameraUnavailable.translation: Ní bheidh an ceamara ar fáil

inviteEnterManually.translation: Cuir isteach nasc cuireadh go lámhaigh

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Tugann cód chliniciúil bailí duit go díreach chuig do mhionsonraí.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Téann cód chlinic dhlíthiúil go díreach chuig do mhionsonraí.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Tabhair cead ceamara i socraíochtaí do bhrabhsálaí, nó cuir isteach an nasc cuireadh go lámhaigh.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ní fhaightear ceamara, cuir isteach an nasc cuireadh a chuir do ospidéal in ionad sin.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Níl an ceamara ar fáil faoi láthair. Cuir isteach an nasc cuireadh go lámhaigh.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Offline? ag taispeáint an grianghraf agallamh a shábháil
